shortcut_name: pairwise constraints reduce directly to bipartite coloring
evidence: "color[v] = color[u] ^ 1"; "check bipartite using BFS"; "start a new component, give smallest vertex colour 0"
affordance_in_statement: To maintain market equilibrium, every dependency must satisfy two strict conditions: 1. At least one of the two commodities involved in the dependency must be assigned to pricing tier 1. 2. At least one of the two commodities involved in the dependency must be assigned to pricing tier 2.
secondary_shortcut_name: component orientation gives the lexicographically smallest coloring
removal_suggestion: The direct bipartite reduction is intrinsic to the stated two-endpoint conditions and cannot be removed by rewording alone. Add a meaningful global coupling condition, such as requiring exactly floor(n/2) commodities to use tier 1, while preserving the examples; the solution must then choose orientations of connected components and verify the global count rather than merely run BFS.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treat every dependency as an undirected edge whose endpoints must receive opposite colors, then use BFS.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: At least one endpoint must be in tier 1 and at least one endpoint must be in tier 2.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Reduce feasibility to bipartiteness and orient each component from its smallest-index vertex to obtain the lexicographically smallest assignment.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Every dependency must satisfy both tier conditions, and multiple assignments must use the lexicographically smallest sequence.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Use BFS two-coloring, with the no-dependency case handled as the all-tier-1 assignment.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Each dependency contains two commodities and requires one tier-1 endpoint and one tier-2 endpoint.

common_affordance: Each dependency is only a local two-commodity constraint requiring its endpoints to have opposite binary tiers, so the whole task is exactly undirected bipartite testing plus component orientation.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: The visible excerpt implements the same bipartite-coloring idea as the survivors, so the supplied trace does not expose a semantic reason for the wrong answer; the defect must be in omitted control-flow or output code rather than in the stated reduction.

recommended_edit: Add a global requirement that exactly floor(n/2) commodities receive tier 1, retaining the existing pairwise conditions and examples. This forces the algorithm to combine component orientations and check a cardinality constraint, defeating a plain bipartite BFS solution.
regression_risk: The edit may accidentally make glm-5 pass on cases where its omitted implementation already happens to produce the required tier-1 count.
